findings.lineage: The D-352 last-heading disposition sweep is internally contradictory.
findings.finding: Two present-tense finding-disposition leaves still point the last-heading repair at D-350. findingDisposition.claudeV26M3 says findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody names basedOn.d350.role as the sole last-heading claimant, but the referenced sibling actually names basedOn.d352.role and basedOn.d350.role expressly says it is not last-heading. findingDisposition.codexV27MustFix says findingDisposition.claudeV21M3 advances to D-350, but that referenced sibling now advances the historical roles and sole claimant to D-352. The first leaf therefore revives a competing D-350 sole-claimant assertion, and both leaves falsely describe the candidate's current fields.
findings.evidence: The operative fields purpose, findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody, and findingDisposition.claudeV21M3 all name basedOn.d352.role as the sole last-heading claimant. basedOn.d352.role says 'Last live heading at dispatch'; basedOn.d350.role says 'Not last-heading. Last-heading custody remains D-352.' Live COORD's final heading is D-352. Nevertheless, the two cited disposition leaves retain D-350. This is not merely a frozen predecessor quotation: each leaf uses an unqualified present-tense reference to a sibling field in this v30 object.
findings.why: The prompt requires basedOn.d352.role to be the sole last-heading claimant and expressly attacks any contrary custody. Finding dispositions assert that earlier MUST-FIX findings landed; they cannot simultaneously misstate the fields that supposedly carry those repairs. The contradictory D-350 recital makes the candidate non-recordable even though its primary custody fields are correct.
findings.requiredCorrection: Advance findingDisposition.claudeV26M3's referenced sole claimant from basedOn.d350.role to basedOn.d352.role. Make findingDisposition.codexV27MustFix accurately describe the current D-352 sweep of findingDisposition.claudeV21M3, while preserving the existing historical finding labels, identifierInvented false, and every frozen Findings-land destination.
